title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am working with two employers (one full time and one part time). 3195 views Q. Theft by me 1917 views Q. I am a surgeon. I want to know status in Islam regarding 5716 views Q. Assalamualaikum, I would like to ask if taking the services of companies like CRYOSAVE etc are BA SHARAH or not. They basically take umbilical cord blood(which is medical waste) just after the birth of babies and store it in their facility. the blood is a rich source of stem cells which can be used by the baby in case of any life threatening disease by implanting them to the affected part.The umbilical cord is the richest source of the best type of stem cells. Is it halaal to store it for a long period of time by freezing it? 2934 views Q. Is it permissible to view animate pictures on Internet computer? 2442 views Q. My wife after few years of marriage filed criminal cases against me and my family members and I also filed cases. Now the matter has been compromised and for settlement I have to pay a huge sum for withdrawal of cases and final settlement, I have finally given Talak to her. The amount is much higher which runs into lakhs of rupees, my question is Whether I can give interest received from Bank in excess of amount of Iddat and maintenance. Your early reply in this regard shall be help me in the right direction. 1619 views Q. After carrying out all religious duties in the right way, are we allowed to play carrom board? Please answer. 3072 views Q. Assalaamualeyikum, I am working as an IT Manager in Multinational Company which creates their own scientific products. I have got an opportunity to work with Multinational Financial Bank (Deutshe Bank). I understand this bank deals in Interest. My job profile in this company will be to maintain their worldwide offices network connectivity. Is it allowed to work in Informaton Technology department in Financial banks... Jazaakumullah... 2148 views Q. As salaamualaikum wrwb Dear Mufti Saab, I work for company called Thomson Reuters. Its a company that provides financial news services to all the big time Financial Instututions ,Banks across the whole world. They have thier own software which is sold to these customers so that they can view all the informationabout Shares of all Halal and Haraam companies, Foreign Exchange and all bonds (fixed income group ie you invest some money and in return earn thorough interest or dividend). So these Banks buy these software to see the market trend and also after geeting inputs from this tools they to buy sell these bonds and trade on shares. Thomson Reuters does not provide and baised news about any Bond or share of the different companies in the market. But only broadcast all the above data to these banks who can run thier business on thier own terms. I work as Software Engineer who will prepare these software for Thomson and also provide better solutions to market this product to the whole Financial world. I have thought that in a way (indirectly) I am supporting the Banks and all Financial institutions to grow or run thier business. Kindly clarify if the money i earn out of these job is completely Halaal or impure. 2258 views Q. Ruling about fixed deposit 15890 views Q. Bank Job 2207 views Q. Job in IT company 2739 views Q. Assalam-U-Alaikum. I am a doctor working with a health company who works for Insurance Companies. Our company has nothing to do with intrest business of insurance company. I only look into the patients hospitalisation claims and monitor the patients queries for medical/consultant treatment. I do not work on any intrest calculation or monitoring. We only take care of health insurance patients only assisting them for hospitalisation, taking treatment and helping them at the hospital. For this service we get paid by insurance companies a fixed fees. I want to ask, whether islam allows me to work in this health company. 4936 views Q. I need a clarification based on Shariyat. My sister got married 3 years ago and still Allah not blessed her with child. After getting much pressure from her husband family, we had consulted with some of the best doctor?s in Chennai. Doctor?s said that, she can?t become conceive in a natural way as she doesn?t have the eggs of her own. The only way they have given us, TEST TUBE Baby using my sister?s husband spem with some other women?s egg. They will inject the both to my sister?s uterus. Referring the about situation, I would like to get clarification based on the Shariyat for the following questions, 1. Test Tube Baby method is allowed in Islam? 2. If it is allowed, then is it fine if we use other women?s egg for it? 3. If this also accepted, Is it acceptable if we get that egg from my another Sister ? 4. Now her husband is forcing her to go by Test Tube baby. Please let us know whether she can accept her husband wish or not if the Tube Baby method is not acceptable in Islam? 5. If the Test Tube method is not acceptable, please let us know on what basis it is not acceptable, as there was no technology like this in our prophet period ? 6892 views Q. What is the opinion of the Ulama of Deoband regarding modern photography, especially in light of some Arab scholars who claim that the prohibition in hadith applies only to hand-drawn images and not to camera photography? 3557 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 161450 Country: India Title: I am a government employee. Last week I got annual prize in terms of money and certificate. Is it halal to use? And I have donated this money to masjid. Is it ok? Question: I am a government employee. Last week I got annual prize in terms of money and certificate. Is it halal to use? And I have donated this money to masjid. Is it ok? Answer ID: 161450 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 964/773/B=8/1439) It is alright to take the prize and use it. It is also alright to donate it to the mosque and it is a cause of reward as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
